align.description: Horizontal alignment for this column's cells *and* its header label, so the two always agree. Defaults to left. Consumers set `"right"` for numeric columns (e.g. `TableField` for Int/Float/Currency/Percent), matching how Frappe desk right-aligns numbers in the grid.

width.description: Initial track width in px, e.g. set from layout/meta. Omit for a flexible column that shares leftover space (`1fr`). Drag-resizing the column's right edge overrides this at runtime.

items.description: Minimal shape `Grid` needs to render a column's header and key its cells. Richer column objects (e.g. FormLayout's `FieldMeta`) satisfy this structurally, so callers pass their own type through `Grid`'s generic and get it back, fully typed, in the `#cell` slot.

disabled.description: Disable structural actions (add/delete/reorder/select) and render read-only.

label.description: Optional heading shown above the grid.

description.description: Helper text rendered below the grid. Hidden while an error is shown.

anyOf.description: Validation error shown below the grid: a message string, or an `Error` with `messages[]`.

error.description: Validation error below the grid: a string, or an `Error` with `messages[]`.

required.description: Renders a `*` next to the label.

newRow.description: Seeds a newly added row. The grid sees only the columns, so whoever knows the whole child form supplies its docfield defaults.

GridProps.description: Props for `<Grid>`. The rows array is a separate `v-model`.

change.description: A row was added, deleted, reordered, or a cell committed (via the slot's `commit`). Carries the new rows array — the intentful "the grid changed" signal, distinct from the live `v-model` sync (the slot's `update`).

align.description: Horizontal alignment for this column's cells *and* its header label, so the two always agree. Defaults to left. Consumers set `"right"` for numeric columns (e.g. `TableField` for Int/Float/Currency/Percent), matching how Frappe desk right-aligns numbers in the grid.

width.description: Initial track width in px, e.g. set from layout/meta. Omit for a flexible column that shares leftover space (`1fr`). Drag-resizing the column's right edge overrides this at runtime.

column.description: Minimal shape `Grid` needs to render a column's header and key its cells. Richer column objects (e.g. FormLayout's `FieldMeta`) satisfy this structurally, so callers pass their own type through `Grid`'s generic and get it back, fully typed, in the `#cell` slot.

commit.description: One cell was committed. Distinct from `change`, which says only that the rows array moved: this names the row and the column, so a consumer can dispatch a per-row event without diffing to work out what moved.

add.description: A row was added, carrying the row so a consumer can address it.

remove.description: Rows were deleted, carrying them as they last were.

edit.description: The user clicked a row's edit action (last column). Carries the row and its index. `Grid` stays oblivious to *how* a row is edited — the consumer (e.g. `TableField`) opens a dialog and renders the row however it likes.
